correctness.rationale: An endomorphism idempotent splits the sink into complementary zero/one eigenspaces, forcing each nonzero arrow line into one summand; conversely any such complementary-subspace union gives idempotent. Maximum projective-cover size M=H+1 follows convexity of q^a+q^(r-a), attained only for line+complementary hyperplane. K=D q^(r-1) maximizers are distinct: two distinct hyperplanes differ by q^(r-2)>=2 projective points. All other covers and pairwise maximal intersections have <=H points, so inclusion-exclusion gives exact leading K(M/D)^n plus O((H/D)^n). Full occupancy inside one maximum cover occurs with relative probability 1-O((H/M)^n) and forces a unique two-part indecomposable splitting. On its event the line allocation is exactly Bin(n,1/M). Independent q=2,r=3 projective enumeration found 28 distinct size-four maximizing covers, each with one fully contained hyperplane; the original projective-support and idempotent verification script was inspected.
